record.label: D5-push/D4-read hybrid residual gate
record.summary: The hybrid saves 27.332B cold FLOPs and 650.740MB versus D4, passes call 0 at residual 0.392053 s, but rank 279 reaches 0.412123 s and fails the strict 0.4 s gate. The one-shot stops without retry, packaging, target access, or submission.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for the D5-push/D4-read spelling after the preregistered rank-279 residual miss; only a distinct byte-exact dispatch/lifetime mechanism with credible physical savings could succeed it.
